detail.longDescription: I asked Enzo Reader to catch me up on my Feedbin feeds inside ChatGPT. The short digest gave me a place to start reading. I also tried search, full-text reading, and the controls for narrowing the list. Search and full text worked; several filters returned errors. I wrote about where I'd use it and where I'd go back to Feedbin. https://www. kylereddoch.me/blog/enzo-reade r-feedbin-chatgpt-review/ # RSS # Feedbin # EnzoReader # ChatGPT
